images.title: One Thousand Gold Bricks
images.caption: Zadik Zadikian, One Thousand Gold Bricks, 1978. Plaster and 24-karat gold leaf. Installation view, Tony Shafrazi Gallery, Tehran, 1978, the gallery’s first and only exhibition, which opened on the eve of the Iranian Revolution. The thousand gilded bricks were later looted and lost. Photo: Tony Shafrazi.
